brief:
Israel's power has long rested not merely on military force but on its ability to construct parallel narratives justifying its actions against Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported. The occupation becomes "defense," the blockade a "security necessity," and civilian deaths "collateral damage" within this framing, according to the analysis.

The reporting suggests Gaza has disrupted this narrative machinery, forcing a confrontation between Israel's constructed justifications and documented reality on the ground.
dek: Israel's power has long rested not merely on military force but on its ability to construct parallel narratives justifying its actions against Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Gaza's reality collapses Israel's decades-old narrative, Shehab Wire reports
